cutting_board.scope: Each task support box becomes a board with the same top surface: local z in [top - thickness, top], same x extent, y widened to half_width_y_m. CUT boards keep the frozen pedestal gap as a relief channel; SLICE-PUSH-01 keeps its 8 mm relief slots.

riser.scope: Grey riser from the table top to the board bottom with the original support x/y footprint, so board plus riser contain the ruler_workcell_v2 extended support box exactly.

blademaster_workcell_v1.friction_scope: 'task_material' resolves to task.material.friction (0.3 for the provisional material) when the scenario is applied; PhysX static and dynamic friction both use it. TLMPM fixture contacts already use the task material friction.
blademaster_workcell_v1.reason: BladeMaster-style workcell: a visible wood cutting board whose PhysX collider equals its visual box, on a grey riser. Inherits the ruler_workcell_v2 +50 mm placement, 35 deg TRIM rake and measured TRIM IK seed. The y widening lies beyond every material particle (|y| <= 15 mm for CUT-01-R/TRIM-01-R/SLICE-PUSH-01, 30 mm for CUT-02), so material support contacts are unchanged. Local material geometry and all scoring thresholds remain inherited; v1/v2 scenarios remain available.

seed_source.scope: Copied from ruler_workcell_v2 (primary-arm Newton geometry preflight). Live execution of blademaster_workcell_v1 NOT_RUN; no SLICE-PUSH-01 IK seed yet.
